claims.claim_text: FY2025 total revenue was $127.7M (down from $158.2M in FY2024); $114.7M (90%) was from U.S. government and $13.0M (10%) from non-U.S. government and commercial. Customers individually exceeding 10% of consolidated revenue contributed $65M, or 51% of revenue for the twelve months ended December 31, 2025.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.object_value: $127.7M total revenue; US gov 90%; customer-concentration $65M = 51% of revenue across 10%+ customers
claims.source_quote: revenue earned from customers contributing in excess of 10% of consolidated revenues was $65 million or 51% of revenue for the twelve months ended December 31, 2025.

claims.claim_text: Total backlog of approximately $248M as of December 31, 2025; $27M of that backlog is attributable to the 10%+ customers; expects to recognize ~100% by end of 2026. Remaining performance obligations (firm signed) of just $8.2M, with 74% to be recognized within 12 months.
claims.subject: BigBear.ai
claims.source_quote: about $27 million of our approximate $248 million of total backlog ... the aggregate amount of the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was $8.2 million.

claims.claim_text: Balance sheet strength: $461.5M total liquidity (cash $87.1M + AFS investments $374.4M) at 12/31/25; raised $637M gross via 142M shares through 3 ATM agreements in 2025; total debt reduced from $200.8M to $17.7M subsequent to year-end (88% reduction).

claims.object_value: $461.5M liquidity; ATM-financed; 142M shares issued in FY2025

claims.claim_text: Pangiam acquisition (Feb 2024) brought biometric/digital identity capabilities; Air Force EPASS program wound down in Q2 2023; 2025 cost of revenues rose to 78% (vs 71% in 2024) reflecting margin compression and mix shift.
